segments.title: Broadcast Open with Pepito
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the show with Executive Producer Pepito; Kendelle walks through frame; Peter Gibbon referenced as news stowaway.

segments.title: Florida Exploding Toilet Lawsuit
segments.notes: Crum appears as 'Eugene Scrum' to cover a Duncan Donuts toilet explosion lawsuit; Crum reveals personal toilet trauma and birthday.

segments.title: Conspiracy Time with Clementine
segments.notes: Clementine Burn broadcasts with dyed red hair claiming identity compromise; covers 10-foot tall aliens in Brazil and Netty Light illuminati conspiracy.

segments.title: Kevin Hart vs. Cat Williams Debate
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate comedic merit; Munch defends Cat Williams as 'unhinged font of pure peak comedic potential'; Crum defends Kevin Hart as Hollywood plant.

segments.title: Lethal Company Patch Notes & Gaming Transition
segments.notes: DJ Music reads Lethal Company v47 patch notes in freestyle rap; Case departs to play Lethal Company with streamer Fiona.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors broadcast, manages studio chaos, departs mid-stream to play Lethal Company with Fiona.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold open, banters with Case, typing limited by paws.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Appears as Eugene Scrum for toilet story; reveals birthday Jan 6, toilet backfire trauma, bad back; later debates Cat Williams vs Kevin Hart.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debates Crum on Cat Williams vs Kevin Hart; claims training, declares victory, dances aggressively.

characters.name: Clementine
characters.notes: correspondent. Hosts Conspiracy Time with red hair disguise; covers 10-foot aliens and Netty Light illuminati.

characters.name: DJ Music
characters.notes: musical correspondent. Delivers Lethal Company patch notes via freestyle rap including Goku persona; transitions broadcast to gaming.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walk-through appearance; hypoglycemic dinner plans discussed; sister Fiona referenced.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Referenced as former producer living in walls; Case threatens to send people to him.

lore_notes.fact: Birthday is January 6th; allergic to most wrapping papers; toilet backfires 30% of the time with floor-mounted flush button; has bad back requiring strain to flush.
Dyed hair red to evade 'Netty Light illuminati consortium'; claims 10-foot tall aliens exist in Brazil and control their biology to maintain exact height.
Claims to have trained for debate; dances with 'sensuality and emotion' when provoked.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell opens the broadcast with Executive Producer Pepito before handing to Crum as 'Eugene Scrum' for a Florida exploding toilet lawsuit story that triggers Crum's personal toilet trauma revelations. Conspiracy correspondent Clementine Burn delivers a red-haired identity-protection segment covering 10-foot Brazilian aliens and the Netty Light illuminati. Debate analysts Munch and Crum clash over Kevin Hart versus Cat Williams, ending with Munch declaring victory through aggressive dance. The broadcast concludes with DJ Music freestyling Lethal Company patch notes as Case departs to play with streamer Fiona.
